Sometimes I add 1/4 a cap of mouthwash and my mouth feels fresh after using. At first, I couldn't figure out why there was a gear or fan shape on to then I twisted it and the head rotated what a genius idea. This is my new favorite hygiene product for sure. oh and it's rechargeable, comes with travel case, and a multitude of attachments.

Works fantastic!! Couple'uh things though: first, make sure to keep your mouth closed at all times or so help me it'll look like God himself has sent a disaster to your bathroom! First use I had water on my mirrors and walls, up my nose and all up in my hair. reviews.t: Effective, Cordless and Plenty of Water Storage
reviews.x: My corded water flosser was getting old and had started to leak, so it was time for a replacement. I love trying new products and updated versions. When I saw a cordless version that would do the same, I jumped at the chance. It is affordable, always a plus, and works with equal water pressure, which is essential as I have tightly spaced teeth. It took me a day or so to get used to the size as it is a little larger than I'd imagined, but the 300 ml water storage is precisely what is needed to do

I love this water flosser. It is as nice, if not better than the leading brand. I use it every morning in the shower, and typically the charge lasts me a couple weeks. It is loaded up with tips, and EXTREMELY adjustable. I would certainly buy it again.

reviews.t: Better than I ever thought it would be.
reviews.x: I was so opposed to getter a water flosser for quite  a while and have come to regret every day I DID NOT use one.  I read all the reviews about how powerful and effective these piks are. Not to be gross but you won’t believe what is washed out of your mouth when you use this. This is a very good product, by the way. It has several levels  of power BUT quite sensitive to the touch of the control buttons. Be prepared to lower the power as needed or water will fly all over!  If anything happens to

I wrote a good review at first, but after reading what others had said and having my own awful experience, I realize this product is trash. It was amazing for the first month and a half. I really needed an easier way to floss with braces. I've struggled with the health of my teeth all of my life, and this product seemed like a godsend.  It only took a little over a month for the device to no longer charge. I'd leave it plugged in, but the light would still be flashing to indicate it was charging

This was ordered for a Christmas gift for my husband.  The quality is very nice, easy to use, good accessories, travel case, and looks good sitting on the bathroom counter.  After only a couple of weeks of use (3x weekly) the water reservoir started leaking.  However, after contacting the seller, another water reservoir was promptly sent out and received.  We have had not had problems since.  Great customer service, great product!

reviews.x: I am one of those poor fools with a bad mouth. Tons of fillings, etc. and a sweet tooth to perpetuate it all - so I have a pretty detailed brushing routine. The floss part has always been aided by the little picks, which I can't stand. I was convinced that I needed a water pick after my parents bought one and loved it, but I wasn't about to spend a fortune on a decent one. This random Amazon flosser has done the trick. It's way more powerful than I expected, easy to plug in when it'll need recha

reviews.t: Stopped working in less then 4 months
reviews.x: The unit worked very well when it worked. It died in less then 4 months! Only issue I had was I kept hitting the mode button from holding it during use. I eventually was able to use it without inadvertently changing the modes. The water tank holds an appropriate amount of liquid for a single use, and the flexible intake tube with gravity ball works as designed. It stopped turning on right after a full charge. It still lights up when I hit the power button, but the motor does not engage. Such a s

I use this product daily and I must say there is a learning curve to a handheld portable waterpik. Thre strongest setting is too hard for me. 1 fill of the tank is enough for a thorough cleaning. Full charge of the battery lasts forever. I've had this about a month and I've only charged it once. Having all the attachments is a plus also and they are easy to change out. The only negative I have to say is that its a little awkward in your hands while cleaning but you get the hang of it fast.

The amount of strength this pik has on the lowest setting was shocking. It can be messy, but I use it over my bathrub with a rinse I am not supposed to swallow. My gums are healing nicely, and the areas I couldn't get clean with floss and a toothbrush are not an issue now (i have malocclussion and impacted wisdom teeth until the dentist can schedule appointments again).

this product does not come with a electric cord to charge the unit. I went to a few different stores to buy one. They all told me that it is a not a universal cord. So I contacted the manufacture. They did not have any in stock and do not know if or when they will be getting some in. JUNK.I would like my money back. But that won't happen.

After my full size water pik died, I decided to get a small compact size machine!  This was just perfect!  It flossed as well as my old machine despite holding less water, It holds the charge for much longer than I expected it to!  I'm so glad that I picked this item, It takes up much less space in my small apartment bathroom!

I have used water flosser in the past. I normally use $15 flosser but it would face problems. Decided to buy this one and I must say it’s worth the money. Really simple to use, good grip, nice speed variations, multiple features, and of course love the travel pouch. Would recommend this product!

At first I was skeptical to buy this product.  But after I read people's reviews I gave it a chance and ordered it.  I am very pleased with my purchase.  Works excellent, battery life is really good and as a bonus for me is it has traveling bag so I can take it with me when I travel.

My dental hygienist recommended the device, not by brand.  I saw others, more expensive, but wanted to try a more frugal device, since I'd never used a water irrigator before.  This is perfect for learning how to use it, in and out of the shower.  This is a purchase I'm glad I made.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the flosser effective and a good value, often comparing it favorably to pricier or name-brand options.
Reviewers frequently praise its cordless, portable design and long battery life, though a few report battery or charging problems.
Several reviewers report the device stopped working or stopped pumping/suctioning water after a period of use.
Some reviewers note missing or required accessories, such as a charging adapter not being included.
A few reviewers mention leaking reservoirs or water spraying messily if the mouth isn't kept closed.
